The illustration shows three stylized male figures in an outdoor setting. In the foreground, a man with glasses and a grey flat cap stands with his arms crossed. He wears a white button-down shirt with dark suspenders and dark trousers. His right hand rests on his left forearm. To his left and slightly behind, a tall, slender man in a long dark coat, dark suit, and tie walks forward. To the right and further back, a third man in a dark three-piece suit with a bowtie walks with his hands in his pockets. The figures have exaggerated facial features. They stand on a sunlit pavement in front of a blurry, light-colored building with large pillars. The background is hazy with warm, golden light.

The text at the top reads: "Laporan Khusus Film Pilihan Tempo H.40" and "Material Ilegal Proyek Strategis Nasional H.90". Below the figures, large white textured letters state "OPERATOR JOKOWI". Smaller text below describes Minister Pratikno's role. A barcode and technical publication details are in the bottom right corner.
